responsibility: Implements GCC’s runtime debug-counter subsystem used by -fdbg-cnt to selectively enable or disable individual transformation events for debugging and bug localization. It builds the name-to-enum mapping from dbgcnt.def, stores per-counter invocation counts and configured closed intervals, parses the -fdbg-cnt option syntax into those interval tables, checks each counter at use sites via dbg_cnt, reports when lower or upper limits are reached to stderr and the active dump file, and can list all counters with their current counts and original configured ranges.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation in the dbgcnt group: it includes dbgcnt.def to build the name-to-enum table, owns the counter state and interval storage, parses -fdbg-cnt settings, and performs runtime checks/reporting. Unlike dbgcnt.def, which only declares the counter list, and dbgcnt.h, which exposes the enum and API declarations, this file contains the operational logic.
